title: The Ice Cold Yeti
description:
Name: [Frostmaw](image:tumblrbumblr:textures/quests/photos/frostmaw.png:150:150)
Known Locations: Open Snowy Biomes. Rare sightings in Taigas
Estimated Size: Huge
Behavior: Often found sleeping while holding an [Ice Crystal](image:mowziesmobs:textures/item/icecrystal.png:50:50). If quiet enough, an opponent can steal the crystal from it, crippling its abilities significantly. Will make large swipes with its arms. If the ice cystal is not taken before the fight, it is put in the Frostmaw's mouth, allowing it to spew a cone of freezing air, and being hit by it enough will freeze its opponent solid for a few seconds. When far, it will shoot a ball of ice, freezing any who it hits immediately. When brought down to just over half health, the Frostmaw will begin to slam the ground with its body, dealing massive damage. The Frostmaw is immune to projectiles but weak to fire.
Danger Level: §4§lHard
